description: This file is a React component that provides a render function for different types of document elements in a Slate.js editor. It includes handlers for layout, text, and custom block elements, as well as rendering logic for specific element types like 'heading', 'link', 'blockquote', 'relationship', and others.

methods.name: renderElement
methods.description: Main rendering function for Slate editor elements, switching based on 'element.type' to render specific React components or HTML elements.

methods.name: CodeElement
methods.description: A subcomponent that renders code blocks with special styling.

methods.name: DividerElement
methods.description: A subcomponent that renders a styled horizontal divider, utilizing 'useSelected' hook to determine if it is selected.
